checks.title: Electron insecure webPreferences (nodeIntegration, contextIsolation, sandbox, webSecurity)
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Renderers run with nodeIntegration off, contextIsolation on, sandbox on and webSecurity on.
checks.remediation: Set nodeIntegration:false, contextIsolation:true, sandbox:true, webSecurity:true; expose a minimal API through a preload script using contextBridge.

checks.title: shell.openExternal or loadURL with unvalidated or remote input
checks.expected_secure_behavior: External URLs are parsed and checked against a protocol and host allowlist before being opened; windows load local or HTTPS-only content.
checks.remediation: Parse with new URL(), allow only https: (and explicitly needed schemes) and a host allowlist before shell.openExternal; load local files with loadFile and HTTPS origins only with loadURL.

checks.title: Auto-update over HTTP or with signature verification disabled
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Updates are fetched over HTTPS and their code signature is verified before install.
checks.remediation: Serve update feeds over HTTPS, keep verifyUpdateCodeSignature enabled, sign releases and pin the publisher name.

checks.title: Connection string with embedded password in application config
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Config files hold no credentials; secrets come from a vault, OS credential store or environment at runtime, or use integrated authentication.
checks.remediation: Remove passwords from config, rotate any exposed credential, and use integrated auth, a secret store or environment injection.

checks.title: Insecure deserialization (BinaryFormatter, ObjectInputStream, pickle)
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Untrusted data is parsed with data-only formats (JSON) or filtered deserializers.
checks.remediation: Replace BinaryFormatter/NetDataContractSerializer with System.Text.Json, use ObjectInputFilter allowlists for Java serialization, and never unpickle untrusted data.

checks.title: DLL search-order and hijack testing
checks.expected_secure_behavior: The application loads libraries only from trusted, non-writable locations with safe search order.
checks.remediation: Use LoadLibraryEx with safe flags, SetDefaultDllDirectories, install to admin-only directories and sign loaded modules. Test on an authorized lab host.

checks.title: IPC and named-pipe authorization testing
checks.expected_secure_behavior: Local IPC endpoints authenticate and authorize callers and restrict ACLs.
checks.remediation: Apply restrictive ACLs to pipes/sockets, verify caller identity and validate all messages. Test on an authorized lab host.
